name: contemporary
label: Contemporary
css: .style-contemporary { background: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 60px; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; } .style-contemporary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 400px; height: 400px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #C800DF) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.08; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .style-contemporary .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; z-index: 1; letter-spacing: -2px; } .style-contemporary .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; z-index: 1; opacity: 0.85; } .style-contemporary .step { position: absolute; top: 60px; right: 60px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); opacity: 0.06; line-height: 1; margin: 0; z-index: 0; } .style-contemporary .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 60px; left: 60px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #C800DF); letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-contemporary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 100%); } .slide-code.style-contemporary .hook { color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-code.style-contemporary .text { color: #E0E0E0; } .slide-code.style-contemporary .step { color: #FFFFFF; opacity: 0.08; } .slide-code.style-contemporary .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #C800DF); } .slide-insight.style-contemporary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f0f1e 0%, #1a1a2e 100%); } .slide-insight.style-contemporary .hook { color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-insight.style-contemporary .text { color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-insight.style-contemporary .insight-text { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 600; color: #FFFFFF; line-height: 1.4; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #C800DF), var(--slide-secondary, #E60076)); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; margin: 40px 0; } .slide-insight.style-contemporary .step { color: #FFFFFF; opacity: 0.06; } .slide-insight.style-contemporary .brand { color: #FFFFFF; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .style-contemporary::before { animation: none; } } @media (prefers-contrast: more) { .style-contemporary .hook { font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -1px; } .slide-code.style-contemporary .text { color: #FFFFFF; opacity: 1; } .slide-insight.style-contemporary .text { color: #FFFFFF; opacity: 1; } }
